title: A white truck with a blue and lime W
label: Brand gallery
lede: Webvan’s brand lived on its trucks: a white box with a big blue and lime W and the wordmark running up the side. These are the brand assets that survive in archived pages, and our own drawings of the van, the totes and the warehouse.

archive.caption: The W mark and wordmark, cropped from the archived home page.
The delivery truck livery, cropped from the photo on the same page.
The name revived by Amazon for shelf-stable groceries.

drawings.title: The van.
drawings.caption: Salaried, trained couriers delivered in 30-minute windows, free over $50, no tipping.

drawings.title: The totes.
drawings.caption: Orders were picked into plastic totes that rode conveyors to the trucks.

drawings.title: The warehouse.
drawings.caption: Oakland: 340,000 sq ft, designed for 8,000 orders a day.

recreation.title: The look, rebuilt
recreation.headline: Free delivery over $50
recreation.body: Text paraphrased from archived 1999–2000 pages. The layout is our recreation, not a copy of the original site.

disclaimer: Colors were sampled from pixels in the archived Nov 2000 page and are approximate because of image compression. Logos appear here in historical and editorial context; Webvan and its marks belong to their owners. Drawings are original recreations.
